title: Telehealth Ledger published telehealth prices (snapshot 2026-11-12)
description: Dated checks of prices that US telehealth programs publish on their own pages. Snapshot saved 2026-11-12: 130 price rows across 31 providers, check dates 2026-10-25 to 2026-11-11. Each row carries the price, its basis, the date it was checked (verifiedAt) and the page it was read from (sourceUrl). Field types here are inferred from the files; definitions are at https://telehealthledger.com/methodology. The publisher earns commission from most of the providers it lists; the files carry no tracked links.
